transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Ha Jung-woo, vice chairman of the strategy committee, visits semiconductor firms to expand ecosystem policies. Confirmed by 디지털데일리.
Small models can replicate on IoT devices, with a 9B model running on 8 out of 9 hardware types. Confirmed by The Financial Express.
An OpenAI employee was arrested for allegedly bugging an executive conference room in San Francisco. Confirmed by NBC News.
Anthropic is reportedly set to reveal Q3 financials on Oct 14, with key metrics on revenue, profitability and compute spending. Still open, per Moomoo.
Nvidia's artificial intelligence chip market share in China fell to 34 percent as Huawei's rose to 28 percent. Reported by 재경일보.
